choices.content: A coin is tossed and lands heads up.
The television is turned on and is showing an advertisement.
A ball drawn at random from a bag containing only red balls is red.
A die is rolled and shows 7.

question.prompt: Which of the following is a certain event?

solutions.explanation: The bag contains only red balls, so any ball drawn must be red. This is a certain event. A and B are random events, and D is an impossible event.
solutions.title: Identifying the guaranteed outcome
